AdditionalInstructions:
Please restart Steam to see it in your library!

NOTE: Please make sure to install the Source SDK Base 2013 Multiplayer and the Source SDK Base 2013 Singleplayer before launching. The Source SDK Base 2013 Singleplayer is required for Half-Life 2 Episode 1 and Half-Life 2 Episode 2 content, which is used by this mod.

To do so, install both from the 'TOOLS' category in your Steam library.

If you would like to have better control over Steam Networking, make sure you also select the "prerelease" beta for Source SDK Base 2013 Multiplayer as well.
